dependencies.name: ecc (cost-tracker Stop hook)
dependencies.purpose: Writes ~/.claude/metrics/costs.jsonl, the spend denominator savings_scorecard.py and skill_roi.py join everything else against.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: savings_scorecard.py shows only the avoided-token numerators (rtk/Headroom/claude-mem/OpenWolf) with no measured-spend denominator; skill_roi.py can't join skill invocations to session cost, so its ROI rows read 'no cost data'.

replacement.suggestion: hand-roll a Stop hook that appends session cost JSON lines to ~/.claude/metrics/costs.jsonl in the schema cost_metrics.py expects
replacement.warning: You'd be reimplementing and indefinitely maintaining ecc's own cost-tracking hook and schema, and every upstream schema change would need to be re-tracked by hand. Installing ecc@everything-claude-code is simpler and stays current for free.

dependencies.name: rtk
dependencies.purpose: Supplies measured input/output token-savings deltas (`rtk gain --daily --format json`) for the scorecard's MEASURED tier.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: The scorecard's rtk row shows 'unavailable — no data'; the MEASURED tier still has costs.jsonl and Headroom.

replacement.suggestion: diff Claude Code's own transcript token counts against a naive baseline yourself
replacement.warning: rtk already does this accounting project-wide and tracks new tool output formats as they change; a hand-rolled parser means maintaining your own diffing logic against every CLI tool's shifting output shape.

dependencies.name: Headroom
dependencies.purpose: Measured input-side compression savings from ~/.headroom/proxy_savings.json + savings_events.jsonl for the scorecard's MEASURED tier.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: The scorecard's Headroom row shows 'no data'; the MEASURED tier still has costs.jsonl and rtk.

replacement.suggestion: write your own wire-compression proxy and savings-event logger
replacement.warning: Headroom's compression heuristics and savings accounting are actively maintained upstream; a hand-rolled proxy needs continual re-tuning and re-securing that installing/enabling Headroom avoids entirely.

dependencies.name: claude-mem
dependencies.purpose: ESTIMATED-tier discovery_tokens numerator from ~/.claude-mem/claude-mem.db for the scorecard's estimated (never-summed-into-measured) tier.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: The scorecard's claude-mem row shows 'no data'; the ESTIMATED tier still has OpenWolf.

replacement.suggestion: build a custom cross-session memory store and self-report its token savings
replacement.warning: claude-mem's memory layer and savings self-reporting already exist and are maintained upstream; a DIY memory layer means owning storage, retrieval, and savings-accounting code claude-mem gives you for free.

dependencies.name: OpenWolf
dependencies.purpose: ESTIMATED-tier per-repo token-ledger.json numerator source, read across ~/dev-local/RHIZE/* repos with a .wolf/ directory.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: The scorecard's OpenWolf row shows 'no data' for repos without a .wolf/ directory; the ESTIMATED tier still has claude-mem.

replacement.suggestion: hand-maintain a per-repo token-ledger file in the same schema
replacement.warning: OpenWolf already tracks this per-repo and evolves its own ledger format; a manual ledger silently drifts the moment that schema changes upstream.

dependencies.name: rhize-skill-monitor
dependencies.purpose: Skill-usage dashboards and benchmarks the skill-dashboard skill renders. The plugin ships no monitor code itself; scripts/skill_monitor_root.sh resolves the checkout via RHIZE_SKILL_MONITOR_ROOT (default ~/dev-local/RHIZE/rhize-skill-monitor), probing for <root>/monitor.py.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: skill-dashboard stops with a clone hint (git clone https://github.com/Rhize-Media/rhize-skill-monitor.git) instead of rendering; nothing else in rhize-ops depends on this tool.

wizard.purpose: Interview you for a delegation recipient and look up their Jira/Slack identifiers automatically where those MCP servers are connected.

artifacts.purpose: Privacy-safe lifecycle receipts for parallel/multi-agent strategy runs, created on first use.
Recipient, tracker, and Slack mapping written by /rhize-ops:delegate-setup.

The standalone rhize-skill-monitor tool's own data: skill-usage.json, skill-cooccurrence.json, stack-metrics.json, recurrence.json, benchmark-status.json, and the snapshots/ and scorecards/ subdirectories. Home defaults to ~/.rhize/skill-monitor unless RHIZE_SKILL_MONITOR_HOME is set or an existing dev checkout's own data/ is in use.
